description: Cover Letter Generator - AI-powered cover letter generation with strict 1:1 TealHQ visual/functional parity. Users select resume, provide job description, configure settings (length, tone, job details), and receive tailored cover letters with WYSIWYG editing and PDF/DOCX export.

userStories.title: Create page structure and route
userStories.description: As a user, I want to access the cover letter generator from the tools page so that I can create tailored cover letters.
acceptanceCriteria: Route exists at /[locale]/tools/cover-letter-generator
Page follows existing tools page pattern (server component)
Unauthenticated users see benefits list + login CTA
Authenticated users see the generator interface placeholder
Back link to tools page present
Hero section with title and subtitle
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser at /en/tools/cover-letter-generator
userStories.notes: Created page.tsx and cover-letter-generator-client.tsx following existing tools pattern.

userStories.title: Add translation keys for cover letter generator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all UI strings externalized to translation files so that the feature supports i18n.
acceptanceCriteria: Add coverLetterGenerator section to src/locales/en/tools.json
Add coverLetterGenerator section to src/locales/fr/tools.json
Add coverLetterGenerator section to src/locales/de/tools.json
Add coverLetterGenerator section to src/locales/it/tools.json
Keys include: title, subtitle, buttons, labels, placeholders, errors, empty states
No hardcoded strings in components
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Added 80+ translation keys across all 4 locale files.

userStories.title: Implement two-column layout (TealHQ parity)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clean two-column layout matching TealHQ so that inputs are on the left and the generated letter is on the right.
acceptanceCriteria: Left column: Input section container (40% width on desktop)
Right column: Output section container (60% width on desktop)
Responsive: stacks vertically on mobile (< 768px)
Consistent spacing and padding with existing tools
Empty state placeholder in right column
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev server
userStories.notes: Two-column responsive grid with md:grid-cols-[40%_1fr].

userStories.title: Integrate ResumeLinker for resume selection
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select one of my saved resumes so that the cover letter is tailored to my experience.
acceptanceCriteria: ResumeLinker component integrated in left column
Dropdown shows all user's resumes (title + last updated)
Selected resume ID stored in component state
Resume content extracted using convertResumeToText() pattern
Error state if no resumes exist (prompt to create one)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: select a resume from dropdown
userStories.notes: ResumeLinker integrated with Supabase fetch and text extraction.

userStories.title: Implement job description input with tabs
userStories.description: As a user, I want to provide a job description via text paste or saved job so that the cover letter targets the specific role.
acceptanceCriteria: Tabbed interface: 'Paste Text' | 'Saved Jobs'
'Paste Text' tab: JobDescriptionInput textarea (min 100 chars)
'Saved Jobs' tab: JobLinker dropdown for saved job applications
Job description stored in component state
Clear visual indication of selected/active tab
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: switch tabs and enter job description
userStories.notes: Tabbed interface with keyboard navigation and ARIA support.

userStories.title: Create generation settings panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure generation settings (length, tone) so that the cover letter matches my needs.
acceptanceCriteria: Length selector: Short | Medium (default) | Long - using radio buttons or segmented control
Tone selector: Casual | Formal (default) | Match Job Description
Custom prompt field: Optional textarea for additional instructions
Settings grouped in a labeled section
Visual styling matches TealHQ (clean, minimal)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: change settings and see selections
userStories.notes: Segmented controls for length, card grid for tone, custom prompt textarea.

userStories.title: Add job details extraction and picker
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to extract key requirements from the job description so that I can select which to emphasize.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse job description client-side to identify 5-10 key points
Display as selectable checkboxes with truncated text
Default: top 3-5 items pre-selected
User can toggle selections on/off
Selected items stored in component state for API call
Graceful handling if extraction yields < 3 items
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: see extracted job details as checkboxes
userStories.notes: Regex-based extraction with selectable checkboxes, top 4 pre-selected.

userStories.title: Create API endpoint for cover letter generation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API endpoint that generates cover letters using AI so that the client can request tailored content.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint: POST /api/tools/generate-cover-letter
Request body: { resumeText, jobDescription, length, tone, selectedDetails, customPrompt, locale }
Uses Groq SDK (BALANCED model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile)
Prompt engineering for professional cover letters with greeting, body, closing
Response: { success, coverLetter }
Error handling with user-friendly messages
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Zod validation, Groq SDK, multi-language support.

userStories.title: Implement Write with AI button and loading state
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click a primary action button to generate my cover letter with clear loading feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Button labeled 'Write with AI' with Sparkles icon
Button disabled until resume AND job description are provided
Button shows loading spinner during generation
Button uses primary color styling (teal/brand color)
Loading skeleton appears in right column during generation
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: click button and see loading state
userStories.notes: Teal primary button, loading skeleton, disabled state logic.

userStories.title: Display generated cover letter
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the generated cover letter in the right column so that I can review it immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty state before generation: helpful placeholder with instructions
Generated letter displays with proper formatting (paragraphs, spacing)
Smooth transition from loading to content
Scroll if content exceeds viewport height
Letter content stored in component state
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: generate letter and see formatted output
userStories.notes: Fade-in animation, scrollable container, paragraph formatting.

userStories.title: Add WYSIWYG editor for cover letter
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit the generated cover letter directly so that I can make manual adjustments.
acceptanceCriteria: Rich text editor wrapping the cover letter content
Basic formatting toolbar: bold, italic, underline
Paragraph handling preserved
Changes persist in component state
Editor matches TealHQ styling (clean, minimal chrome)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: edit text and apply formatting
userStories.notes: ContentEditable with B/I/U toolbar, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+B/I/U).

userStories.title: Implement Improve with AI button
userStories.description: As a user, I want to regenerate or refine the cover letter with new settings so that I can iterate on the content.
acceptanceCriteria: Button appears in action bar after initial generation
Button labeled 'Improve with AI' with Wand icon
Clicking regenerates cover letter with current settings
Loading state during regeneration
Updated content replaces previous in editor
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: click improve and see new content
userStories.notes: Wand2 icon, calls same API with current settings.

userStories.title: Add copy to clipboard functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to copy the cover letter to clipboard so that I can paste it into job applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Copy button in cover letter action bar with Copy icon
Copies plain text (strips HTML formatting)
Visual feedback on copy: icon changes to Check for 2 seconds
Toast notification: 'Cover letter copied to clipboard'
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: click copy and paste elsewhere
userStories.notes: Visual feedback with Check icon, fallback for older browsers.

userStories.title: Add PDF download functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download the cover letter as PDF so that I can attach it to applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Download PDF button in action bar with FileDown icon
Uses html2pdf.js (same as resume export)
Clean formatting: proper margins (1 inch), readable font (12pt)
Filename: Cover_Letter_[timestamp].pdf
Loading state during PDF generation
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: download PDF and open in viewer
userStories.notes: html2pdf.js with 72px margins, Georgia serif font.

userStories.title: Add DOCX download functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download the cover letter as DOCX so that I can edit it in Word.
acceptanceCriteria: Download DOCX button in action bar with FileText icon
Uses html-to-docx (same as resume export)
Preserves formatting (paragraphs, basic styles)
Filename: Cover_Letter_[timestamp].docx
Loading state during DOCX generation
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: download DOCX and open in Word
userStories.notes: docx library with proper paragraph styling.

userStories.title: Add language selector for generation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate cover letters in my preferred language so that they match the job market I'm targeting.
acceptanceCriteria: Language selector dropdown: English, French, German, Italian
Default: current page locale
Selected language passed to API for AI generation
Label: 'Output Language'
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: change language and generate letter in that language
userStories.notes: Dropdown in settings section, passed to API locale param.

userStories.title: Implement error handling and edge cases
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear error messages when something goes wrong so that I know how to fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: Error alert if AI generation fails with retry button
Validation error if resume content is empty or too short
Validation error if job description is too short (< 100 chars)
Network error handling with user-friendly message
All errors displayed in dismissible alert component
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: trigger validation error and see message
userStories.notes: Dismissible alerts, retry button, pre-validation checks.

userStories.title: Add empty states with guidance
userStories.description: As a user, I want helpful empty states that guide me through the process.
acceptanceCriteria: No resume selected: 'Select a resume to get started' message
No job description: 'Add a job description to tailor your letter' message
No generated letter: Placeholder with Mail icon and instructions
Empty states include relevant icons
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser: see empty states before completing inputs
userStories.notes: Guidance hints with Info/CheckCircle2 icons.

userStories.title: Ensure accessibility compliance
userStories.description: As a user with accessibility needs, I want the feature to be fully accessible so that I can use it with assistive technologies.
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements keyboard accessible
ARIA labels on buttons, inputs, regions
Focus management: focus moves logically through form
Color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for text)
Screen reader announcements for loading/success/error states
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Live regions, fieldsets, role attributes, keyboard navigation.
